findings.old: It belongs to the four elements—fire, air, earth, and water—and to the four humors: yellow bile, phlegm, blood, and black bile.
findings.new: It belongs to the four elements—fire, air, earth, and water—which are yellow bile, phlegm, blood, and black bile.
findings.reason: Canonical Arabic وهو للعناصر الأربعة النار والهواء والتراب والماء وهي الصفراء والبلغم والدم والسوداء identifies the listed elements with the following substances through وهي (“and they are”). Keep this readable odd identification literally; “and to the four humors” instead invents a separate parallel association.
